description: This file defines the WidgetStateManager class responsible for managing widget state persistence, restoration, and deletion in an Android app. It handles shared preferences for storing widget settings and interacts with AppWidgetManager for widget updates.

classes.name: WidgetStateManager
classes.description: Manages widget state persistence, restoration, and deletion, including interacting with shared preferences and analytics.

methods.name: saveWidgetState
methods.description: Saves the state options of a widget with a specific widget ID into shared preferences and logs the event.

methods.name: loadWidgetState
methods.description: Loads and returns the saved state options of a widget with a specific widget ID from shared preferences.

methods.name: deleteWidgetState
methods.description: Removes the stored state options for a widget with a specific widget ID and logs the deletion event.

methods.name: restoreWidgets
methods.description: Restores the states of multiple widgets based on stored preferences and triggers their update if preferences exist.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Provides a singleton instance of WidgetStateManager, ensuring only one exists per context.
